requested_use: Internal company use for final production gearbox design and service-load ratings
distribution_constraint: GitHub-publishable source, examples and reference fixtures; no proprietary standards or private calculation package

independent_shaft_reference.scope: Three-axis support reactions, bending deflection/slope, axial displacement and twist for point forces/couples, overhangs, hollow/solid stepped sections; not fatigue or bearing life

native_packages.status: Final rc5 Windows package build running; rc4 native evidence is historical

limitations: Elastic Euler-Bernoulli bending, Saint-Venant torsion and axial extension on circular sections with two ideal radial supports and one axial locator.
Reference comparisons verify selected reactions and movements, not fatigue, material allowables or assembled gearbox life.
Nominal surface stress excludes transverse shear, notch concentration, residual stress and fatigue.
Bearing stiffness/preload/capacity, housing, retention, rotor dynamics, buckling and physical qualification remain outstanding.
Imported gear forces are ideal; actual friction-loss distribution and actual support/manufacturing dimensions require additional input.
Runtime remains independent of the isolated reference solver; no reference implementation is bundled.
Native archives are unsigned; acceptance on actual company workstation images remains outstanding.
